note: This is a curated reading list, not a live feed. The site is static, so I add links by hand. Dates are when the item was published or the event happened; check each source for anything newer.

sections.name: primary sources to follow
sections.blurb: Check these directly for current news. No dates because they update continuously.

items.title: OWASP GenAI Security Project: LLM Top 10
items.note: The standard list of LLM application risks. Start here.

items.title: MITRE ATLAS
items.note: ATT&CK-style matrix of attacks on AI systems, with case studies.

items.title: NIST AI Risk Management Framework
items.note: Governance-level guidance. Useful vocabulary for interviews.

items.title: NIST AI 100-2: Adversarial Machine Learning taxonomy
items.note: Names and classifies attacks on ML systems and their mitigations.

items.title: CISA: Artificial Intelligence
items.note: US government guidance on secure AI use and deployment.

items.title: Simon Willison on prompt injection
items.note: Running, readable record of real prompt injection cases.

items.title: FIRST EPSS
items.note: A model that scores how likely a CVE is to be exploited. A good example of useful boring ML.

sections.name: milestones worth reading
sections.blurb: Events and publications referenced in this section, newest first.

items.title: DARPA AI Cyber Challenge finals at DEF CON
items.note: Teams built systems that find and patch vulnerabilities in open-source code autonomously.

items.title: From Naptime to Big Sleep
items.note: An LLM-based agent finds a real memory-safety bug in SQLite. Read the limits the authors state.

items.title: EU AI Act enters into force
items.note: Obligations phase in over several years.

items.title: Attention Is All You Need
items.note: The transformer paper behind modern LLMs.
